candidates.name: Mycosis Fungoides
support_spans: Numerous pink-purple dermal papules were present on the trunk and extremities, with preference for the extensor surfaces of the arms and legs
Nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate (H&E stain)
Admixed atypical, irregularly contoured lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample
candidates.why: The patient's skin lesions and lymph node findings are consistent with Mycosis Fungoides, a type of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
